main.description: Records a membership payment: a USDC transfer on Base from a wallet linked to the member (this repo) to a wallet linked to the creator, of at least the plan's price. The indexer checks the transaction; a verified payment makes the member active for 30 days from the transaction's block time, or extends a membership that is still active by 30 days from its current expiry.

creator.description: The account offering the plan; the repo of the plan record.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the transaction. Only Base ('eip155:8453') is accepted.

txHash.description: Hash of the transaction holding the USDC transfer. One transaction backs one payment or tip only, and it must be at most 24 hours older than this record.
